svg.text: Week10 - APT29 vs KZ brand phishing
MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise v20.1 · 31 techniques · shown: techniques in this layer only

g.title: T1598 Phishing for Information — KZ phishing only: Collect brand assets / wording for lures
T1583.001 Acquire Infrastructure: Domains — BOTH. APT29: Sender domains bakenhof[.]com, silry[.]com | KZ: Look-alike domains (kaspl[.]ga, egov-kz-pay[.]online)
T1584.004 Compromise Infrastructure: Server — APT29 only: Compromised WordPress server hosts the ZIP / HTA
T1588.004 Obtain Capabilities: Digital Certificates — APT29 only: RDP file signed with a Let's Encrypt certificate
T1608.005 Stage Capabilities: Link Target — KZ phishing only: Credential-capture page staged behind the link
T1566.001 Phishing: Spearphishing Attachment — BOTH. APT29: Attached lure document with link (A); .RDP file attached (B) | KZ: Kazpost-themed .docm attachment (week 5, H3)
T1566.002 Phishing: Spearphishing Link — BOTH. APT29: Link to invite.php (A) / to wine.zip (C) | KZ: SMS / messenger / e-mail link: 'parcel held', 'eGov payout'
T1053.005 Scheduled Task/Job: Scheduled Task — KZ phishing only: Scheduled task persistence (lab emulation)
T1059.001 Command and Scripting Interpreter: PowerShell — KZ phishing only: Word -> PowerShell (weeks 5 and 7)
T1204.001 User Execution: Malicious Link — BOTH. APT29: Victim clicks the link in the invitation | KZ: Victim opens the link
T1204.002 User Execution: Malicious File — BOTH. APT29: Victim opens invite.hta / .rdp / wine.exe | KZ: Victim opens the attachment
T1574.001 Hijack Execution Flow: DLL — APT29 only: DLL side-loading: SqlDumper.exe / wine.exe (PowerPoint)

T1547.001 Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Registry Run Keys / Startup Folder — BOTH. APT29: Run key POWERPNT (C); Run key per Zscaler (A); AutoStart possible after RDP (B) | KZ: Implant autostart (lab emulation, week 8)
T1055.003 Process Injection: Thread Execution Hijacking — APT29 only: WINELOADER thread execution hijacking (Mandiant table)
T1027 Obfuscated Files or Information — APT29 only: RC4-encrypted core module, junk-code DLL
T1140 Deobfuscate/Decode Files or Information — APT29 only: certutil -decode rebuilds invite.zip
T1218.005 System Binary Proxy Execution: Mshta — APT29 only: ROOTSAW runs as an HTA (mshta.exe)
T1684.001 Social Engineering: Impersonation — BOTH. APT29: Poses as CDU, Microsoft/AWS staff, a European MFA | KZ: Poses as Kaspi, eGov, Kazpost, CDEK
T1056.003 Input Capture: Web Portal Capture — KZ phishing only: Fake login / card form captures data
T1111 Multi-Factor Authentication Interception — KZ phishing only: Fake form asks for the Kaspi SMS code
T1033 System Owner/User Discovery — APT29 only: Username sent in first beacon
T1057 Process Discovery — APT29 only: Process discovery (Mandiant table)
T1082 System Information Discovery — BOTH. APT29: Host fingerprint: computer name, process | KZ: Host discovery (CALDERA, week 8)
T1083 File and Directory Discovery — KZ phishing only: File discovery (CALDERA, week 8)
T1005 Data from Local System — BOTH. APT29: Victim drives exposed over the RDP session | KZ: Stage local data
T1039 Data from Network Shared Drive — APT29 only: Network drives exposed over the RDP session
T1115 Clipboard Data — APT29 only: Clipboard redirected to attacker RDP server
T1071.001 Application Layer Protocol: Web Protocols — BOTH. APT29: HTTPS GET/POST beacons to C2 | KZ: C2 over HTTPS
T1105 Ingress Tool Transfer — APT29 only: Second stage downloaded after the click
T1041 Exfiltration Over C2 Channel — KZ phishing only: Exfiltration over C2
T1567 Exfiltration Over Web Service — KZ phishing only: Exfiltration to web service / Telegram bot
